name: Scotland
title: The Kingdom of Scotland
pressure_shape: Coastal growth: coastal Explores add Towns (L1), Coastal Lands card moved earlier and a City in land #2 (L2), coastal Builds without Invaders (L3), a Stage III card moved earlier (L4), Ocean Blight (L5), Inland Towns after Ravage (L6); loses when Coastal lands with City exceed 2 per board.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Ports Sprawl Outward
stage_ii_escalation.text: On the single board with the most Coastal Town/City, add 1 Town to the N lands with the fewest Town. (N = # of players.)

loss_condition.title: Trade Hub
loss_condition.text: If the number of Coastal lands with City is ever greater than (2 x # of boards), the Invaders win.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheKingdomOfScotland), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.7 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Ports Sprawl Outward): On the single board with the most Coastal Town/City, add 1 Town to the N lands with the fewest Town. (N = # of players.) Additional loss condition (Trade Hub): If the number of Coastal lands with City is ever greater than (2 x # of boards), the Invaders win.
levels.notes: R-ADV-SCO-L0a, R-ADV-SCO-L0b. Escalation happens before Exploring; its Towns can be Explore sources that turn (NQ-G). Players break ties (Q21). With a combined adversary, other setup pieces bound for a Coastal land other than #2 go to an adjacent Inland land (Q19).

levels.name: Trading Port
levels.escalation: After Setup, in Coastal lands, Explore Cards add 1 Town instead of 1 Explorer. “Coastal Lands” Invader Cards do this for maximum 2 lands per board.
levels.notes: R-ADV-SCO-L1. Wiki errata: an Explore adding 2 Explorers adds 1 Town + 1 Explorer; Towns added by Explore are not sources for that Explore.

levels.name: Seize Opportunity
levels.escalation: During Setup, add 1 City to land #2. Place “Coastal Lands” as the 3rd Stage II Card, and move the two Stage II Cards above it up by one. (New Deck Order: 11-22-1-C2-33333, where C is the Stage II Coastal Lands Card.)

levels.name: Chart the Coastline
levels.escalation: In Coastal lands, Build Cards affect lands without Invaders, so long as there is an adjacent City.

levels.name: Ambition of a Minor Nation
levels.escalation: During Setup, replace the bottom Stage I Card with the bottom Stage III Card. (New Deck Order: 11-22-3-C2-3333)

levels.name: Runoff and Bilgewater
levels.escalation: After a Ravage Action adds Blight to a Coastal land, add 1 Blight to that board’s Ocean (without cascading). Treat the Ocean as a Coastal Wetland for this rule and for Blight removal/movement.

levels.name: Exports Fuel Inward Growth
levels.escalation: After the Ravage Step, add 1 Town to each Inland land that matches a Ravage Card and is within 1 Range of Town/City.
levels.notes: R-ADV-SCO-L6. Wiki copy of this text is truncated; engine text used.
